mission_06: Excellent! You have verified the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus both analytically and numerically. The integral of 3x^2 + 2x - 1 from 0 to 3 equals F(3) - F(0) = 33. You confirmed that the derivative of the accumulation function G(x) equals the original function f(x). The total area between the curve and x-axis from -2 to 2 accounts for sign changes at the roots. The FTC is one of the most important results in mathematics — it unifies the two central operations of calculus and enables us to compute definite integrals using antiderivatives.
